name: count-lines
description: Show the number of lines in the currently selected text (falls back to clipboard).
author: Joao
title: Count Lines

commands.name: count-lines
commands.title: Count Lines
commands.description: Show the number of lines in your current selection; fallback to clipboard if needed.

preferences.name: ignoreTrailingBlank
preferences.title: Counting Options
preferences.description: Ignore trailing blank lines at the end of the selection (recommended).
preferences.label: Ignore trailing blank lines

preferences.name: alsoShowNonEmpty
preferences.description: Also compute non-empty lines (excludes whitespace-only lines) and include in HUD.
preferences.label: Also show non-empty lines

preferences.name: copyResultToClipboard
preferences.description: Copy the numeric line count to your clipboard after running the command.
preferences.label: Copy result to clipboard

preferences.name: fallbackToClipboard
preferences.description: If selected text can't be read, fall back to reading text from the clipboard.
preferences.label: Fallback to clipboard if selection unavailable
